balls.text: swung away straight down deep midwicket's throat! Low full toss, Livingstone hit it well but ended up picking out the lone man in the deep. The SRH innings has decelerated sensationally. CSK will be mighty happy with this comeback. SRH have crossed their previous-best of 192 against CSK, but the 200 remains elusive.
slants one across, the batter leaves anticipating it to be a wide, not called. They scamper a bye

looks for a repeat, but the angle was far wider and across the batter, Shivang still goes through with the shot and ends up tamely looping it to Gurjapneet at short fine leg. Clever bowling, Kamboj's impressive season continues.
picked away, useful runs. This is very cleverly done, he walks across, gets down low to scoop this low full toss to the fine leg boundary
excellent from Kamboj, dug out to long-off again. Lengths so good that batters aren't able to to get underneath the length.
hit hard to long-off
dug out to cover at the edge of the ring
how far has this gone? Very far. This was full, right into his pads and Shivang picks him away to clear deep midwicket. This was pace on, so all he had to do was time this well, which he did.
beaten by the slower one! Swung through even before the ball arrived
looks to go off-cutter and take it away from the hitting arc, ends up spearing it too far wide outside off, wide called and rightly so
right into the blockhole, dug back
dug out to cover, no chance of a single. Livingstone had to put in a dive anticipating a direct hit at the bowler's end.

straight into Brewis' mitts at deep cover! Gurjapneet does well to bowl full and take this across, somewhat away from his hitting arc. Arora does well to reach that but he's also taking on the longest pocket at the ground, finds Brewis intercepting that with ridiculous ease.
takes it away from Livingstone, who looks to angle this behind point but is beaten again
superb bowling this! Spears in a wide yorker, dug back to the bowler.
right into the blockhole again, squeezed off a thick inside edge to deep backward square leg
full on leg-stump, deflects off the pad to short fine.

drags this back onto the stumps!  Kamboj's impressive season continues. What a massive moment. Once again it's the angle that he takes across from wide of the crease, Klaasen believes he's got room to scythe this behind point, apparently not. Drags back.
yorker-length, away from the swinging arc, beaten
heaved into the leg side and the connection is sweet! Picked his spot and timed it well. Beat deep midwicket.
pulled in front of square to deep midwicket
whips this down to wide long-on, excellent running to come back for the second
slips one down leg, Klaasen looks to nudge it fine but misses. Wide called.
off the bottom edge and past the keeper for four! Klaasen was looking to back away and slap it through point, but they all count nontheless.
lofted but no timing, the ball plonks wide of long-off
hit high on the bat as he looks to pull, good work by the deep midwicket fielder coming in.
sharp turn back in off a length to beat Arora's inside edge, good grab by Sanju.
looks to cut but there's no room, chopped into the leg side off the inside edge
whips this shortish delivery towards deep midwicket
slaps this short ball to sweeper cover
wrong'un on a length on middle, whipped to deep midwicket. His 10th fifty in the IPL

in the slot and out of the park! His strike rate against Noor coming into this game as at 244, and that dominance shows. Too full, Klaasen got down on one knee and muscled it over deep midwicket. Sensational strike.

slants a back-of-the-hand slower deliver across the right-hander, but ends up spearing it nearly outside the wide line as the batter leaves. Touch and go.  The call has been reviewed by CSK  A millimetre of the ball was inside the wide line projector. Decision reversed.
full toss and whacked! Enough width on that one and Arora doesn't miss out as he Tonks it to the deep extra cover boundary
tight bowling this. Slower and fuller delivery angling away, Arora was winding up to swing but changed his mind at the last moment
full, misses the yorker by a small margin, flicked to deep midwicket
spears in a superb yorker on middle, gets some late tail away, dug out
pushed into the covers for a single
works it to mid-on for a quick single to get off the mark

another one bites the dust and Overton's surge continues. NKR looks to muscle this over long-on but the ball got a tad bigger on him which meant he didn't get the kind of elevation he would've liked. Well held at long-on. Had the promise of a more-impactful innings. Short was a couple of yards in, so he had to leap high to get to that and he did that quite nicely.
nudged into the leg side for a single
full on the pads, flicked into the gap between deep midwicket and wide long-on, outstanding running
takes on the short ball and gets a big, fat top-edge over the keeper's head for four.
punched towards midwicket
gets a leading edge, nearly carried to the bowler
more agony for Noor. He went around the wicket to spin it back into him, but Klaasen fetches it from outside off and reverse-swaps him over short third. Incredible hand-eye coordination
rocks back and pulls this short ball down to long-on
drifts one across the batter, who bunts it to point, looks for a single but is sent back
sharp turn back into middle and leg off a length, worked towards deep midwicket
pulled to deep midwicket
muscled over long-on! Properly into NKR's swinging arc and he displays brute force in flat-batting this. Had to do the heavy lifting since bowler went pace off, made it look effortless.
slaps this down to long-off again, Gurjapneet took pace off
full, slot-ball and that has been drilled down the ground, a valiant attempt by long-off but he can't stop that. Sarfara covered good ground and then put in the dive, but he palms it
looks to force this slower delivery back past the bowler, hits it back to Gurjapneet on the followthrough
length ball angling away, bunted past the bowler for a single
whips this low full toss to wide long-on
pushed down to long-on as they jog the single
once again, very sensibly done. Works this with the angle towards the man running in from the ropes at deep midwicket. Good running.
nicely done, nudges this full delivery on the pads towards deep midwicket, they amble back for the second
looks to play a short-arm jab but is beaten by the skid off the pitch
bunts it gently to mid-on as they scamper a single, Nitish is off the mark

and the slide continues. Overton goes hard-length on middle-and-off, Aniket looks to take on the short ball but ends up skewing it high off the bat to midwicket. No timing or power, and he was very late on the shot.
Boshed but not timed. Aniket went for a slog sweep on one knee, but the ball was held back more than expected. Flies close to long leg but falls short
Pulls back his length to a good one in front of the stumps once more. Swipes this towards long-on
Too full and on the pads, so Klaasen responds with a thumping sweep to long leg! Not the line to bowl to Klaasen as a spinner

And now the edge flies down to vacant deep third! Bowls quicker, uses the wrong 'un to deceive Klaasen going for a cross-batted pull. That awkward angle from over the stumps cramped his shot and took the outside edge
On a length, driven down to long-on with ease
Pushed full, on the stumps and spinning away from Klaasen. Driven down to long-off
Full and well outside off, Aniket shovels this towards point but cannot get it past the fielder
Speared into the blockhole, on Klaasen's pads. He almost goes off balance as he flicks this towards deep square leg
Kept well outside off, and right inside the wide crease. Klaasen lets it go and has an intense look in his eyes as he looks at the umpire, but was never a wide
Now a slower one, dies on him as it tails away from outside off! Klaasen looks for a poke but pulls out of it last minute. Barely moved his feet
That's vintage Klaasen for you. Too full, right on the stumps, and he bashes this one across the line and into cow corner
On a good length, on the fuller side and on the off-stump line. Punched towards covers

Woof, what a ripper out of nowhere. Back of a length and just shapes away from Abhishek. The ball flies off the pitch and towards Sanju, who insists on a review. Could be a faint edge here... And there's a big spike as the ball passes bat. Just like that, Abhishek's been taken out!
Full and drifting into Klaasen's pads. There to be hit, but he can't get back on ball as it runs away to backward square leg
Full and on the stumps. Abhishek is happy to bunt this one down the ground. 123.1 clicks, a slower one, so it dribbles away to extra cover without much timing on it
Now fuller and on the pads. Holds his pose with a high-elbow drive towards deep extra cover, then takes off for the run
Abhishek's innings has been on pause for a bit. Now. he's back to hitting 'em big: in the slot outside off, angling away from him. He just reaches out and lofts this over the extra cover fielder
Overton bangs this in back of a length, just outside off. Klaasen uses those long levers of his to drop this near the point fielder, and take off
Full and drifting down leg, Klaasen can't lay bat on ball. It's leg-byes as the ball dribbles away right behind him, to where a long stop would be
Shivam Dube's absolutely shelled this one near deep midwicket! The ball was full, flicked off his pads. Didn't time this enough to get it over the ropes. Noor doesn't shoot a pleasant look to Dube
On a length and on leg stump, drifting back into the right-handed Klaasen. Happy to flick this towards square leg and takes off
Full and on the pads, flicked late towards fine leg, where the fielder collects it
Full and on the stumps, Abhishek happy to toing this one down to long-on and get to the other end
Now Noor fires it in even fuller, even wider. Outside the wide crease. Sanju's stopped it this time but he'll have to reload anyway
Well well, Sanju's let this one slip past him... Noor drifts this one in from outside off, barely any turn on it and near the wide line. Evades Samson and runs away to the ropes behind him

Slammed straight to mid-off! Mistimed this ball outside off. Kishan just swings at it like he's wielding an axe too heavy in his hand. Loses his shape and deposits it to Gaikwad once more. He's taken two in two. Welp (for SRH fans)... It's game on for the CSK ones!

Can you believe this? The worst ball of the over, a full toss offered up right outside off. Head boshes this one and somehow spears it straight to Gaikwad stationed at mid-off for that exact shot. How did he find the fielder off that ball! The ebbs and flows of T20 cricket, you suppose...
Now it's offered up in the slot outside off for variety, and Travis dissects the field to place this past point
Now he gets on one knee and just carves this with a quasi-pull! Right in the slot, once more. On the stumps and Head is down on his knees in a jiffy and finds the gap past square leg
Walks into the off side and gets another ball in the full-ish area, drives this down to mid-off. If he beat him, would have been a sureshot boundary
Travis Head gets going, says "Don't mind if I do". Mukesh floated this up, perfectly content with a good length ball. But Head just gets on his tippy-toes and clear Noor Ahmed at extra cover

And now he charges even further down the ground to thrash it over deep extra cover! He's brought up a 15-ball 50, and he's pulling out the "L" celebration and waves it around the crowd. Just been slot bowling this over, and too slow for Abhishek to not just charge him, because it isn't turning much
Almost an action replay. Actually, more of an improvement on the prequel: he gives himself even more room. Floated up, following him on the stumps, but Abhishek carves this over extra cover

And now he's carved this over deep cover! He swivels down to the leg side as if he has an appointment there, then heaves the full ball with an inside-out loft. The fielder from the infield gives chase but can't pull it back.

Yeah you float it up on a good length, and you see? He hits you over the long-on boundary anyway. Bonkers hitting against the off-spinner bowling the extra over. He's into the leg side once more, minimal movement at the crease, it's right under his eyeline and then over the ropes
Abhishek's seeing it soooo well now. He opens up his front leg and smashes this slot ball right down the ground. Can't bowl there, can't bowl most areas...
Short of a good length, outside off. Travis reaches for this and pulls it across the line, to midwicket

Now the ball flies over deep third! This is why Abhishek's so good when in form: he keeps charging down the pitch and slashing at it, consequences on his numbers forgotten for the moment. Was on a good length on a leg stump line, but converted into a slot ball right under Abhishek's eyes
Shuffled down the ground, into leg side, and he lofts this one over deep extra cover! Abhishek converted it to a full ball
Now Kamboj goes full and outside off once more. Head cuts this along the ground, towards deep point, where the fielder runs in for a comfortable stop
And now a cross-batted swipe, still inside his crease. It was on a length and kept low, attacking the stumps. Head just swiveled his hips at this one but found the fielder at square leg
Kamboj corrects with a good length ball on the stumps, moving away from Head. Punches a drive but finds the packed covers region once more
Head might be on 3 off 10, but he isn't missing those. Kamboj angles this far outside off, but it's right in the slot. Head throws his hands at it and the ball flies over deep cover
Now he stays in his crease, deep in the leg side. Carves a drive towards deep extra cover and sets off for a run. At least he'll keep strike
Head's been busy on those feet, but to no avail! Pitched on the stumps, Head goes for a drive but can only fend this down the pitch and back to the bowler
Driven from outside off straight to covers. Head shuffled into the leg-side for this one, but can't find the gap
And now he almost French cuts onto his stumps! Slightly wider, Abhishek frees his arms to drag this ball from outside off and into the leg side. But it gets the under-edge and dribbles away
Abhishek's waited around enough! To be fair, this was right in the slot. Abhishek keeps still, opens up his front foot, and just bashes this one from outside off to outside the park!
Head shuffles down the pitch, finds the inside edge of his bat! Was full and on the stumps, Short found some drift on this to deceive Head in flight. He pushes it towards mid-on anyway
Strays into the pads off a length once more. Head more than happy to oblige with a flick towards long leg
Back of a length, swinging into the batter, who drives this down the ground! Fielder runs in from long-on so can't get back for a second run
Bangs in a bouncer, Head does the smart thing and crouches to get his, err, head out of the way. Wasn't too quick but Head wants nothing to do with it
Pushes this ball full and outside off, swinging back in. A late dab past point and it's a quick outfield

Errs in line with a full ball down the pads. An easy flick towards deep midwicket, which lies empty. But the fielder runs in from deep square leg with a dive to cut it off. Short there - the player, that is!
And now Abhishek frees his arms! We've been waiting for you. Outside off, back of length. He maintains his shape and just carves this drive over deep extra cover
Another solid cut off a good length, spinning back into Head. The covers aren't letting this one through either
Drifting down leg, spinning away even further. Sanju appeals for an edge, there wasn't any. Time to reload
On a length, and spinning back into the bowler even closer to the leg-stump line. Driven down to mid-off and Abhishek happy to settle for a single
Steps down the pitch to convert this to a full-ish ball, past the diving fielder and to mid-on
On a length once more, cramps the line even closer to off stump. Head goes on the back foot and cuts this to backward point
Kept on a length well outside off, spinning back in. He drives this to a packed covers
Around the wicket, on a length outside off. Abhishek dabs this late towards backward point

That's that, it's all over. SRH have pulled off a tight win that looked unlikely when CSK went hammer and tongs in the powerplay. Hinge closes it out with a superb yorker that is dug out to the leg side.  SRH surge to a third win now.
into the blockhole on leg-stump, whipped to deep midwicket

he has shovelled this straight down long-off's throat. Once again full and angling across, Overton can't generate the kind of power he'd like. Turns out to be the simplest of catches for Livingstone. Hinge has his arms wide. He's had a rough night with the ball, but has done wonderfully well so far to try and close this out. Now to finish it
this won't hurt SRH, the yorker is squeezed into the leg side towards midwicket

that's a high full toss, well over the waist and angling away, Kamboj swings and misses That's a no-ball, so it's time for a free-hit. Not sure why SRH chose to review such an obvious call. Sure they had review to burn, but really? For this?
can't get that away! Hinge looks to spear a leg-stump yorker but this turns out to be a half-volley, Overton is hit on the pad as he looks to flick, they scamper a leg bye. 15 off 4
full toss on middle and leg from round the stumps, worked towards deep midwicket
toe-ends this hack down to long-on, they somehow manage to scamper back for the second. NKR went length into the pitch.
pressure beginning to tell. This is speared too far wide outside off. Left alone, wide called.
he has absolutely bludgeoned that over the ropes! Nice, high full toss, and Kamboj is strong! Picked the bones out of it. That's a massive hit, will relieve a lot of pressure. Game on!
hacks this down to long-on, no timing once again. Looked to go a lot straighter but ended up dragging it.
drilled over the infield, on the bounce to sweeper cover. They can't pick the gap still.
slaps this length ball to long-off for a single
low full toss, drilled back. NKR puts his right hand out as he stops in his followthrough
yorker-length on middle and leg, squeezed to deep midwicket
short outside off, pulled towards deep midwicket, two more, Kishan retrieves

walks into the stroke as he whips this full delivery into the gap at deep midwicket. Shivang does well to get to the ball but in trying to parry it to the fielder running around from long-off, he ends up pushing it over the triangles.
Arora, the keeper, had all three stumps to aim at to run out Overton at the strikers end after he missed to connect this full delivery. But he misses. It's more importantly a dot
drilled to long-on again, the boundary eludes them again as Klaasen comes around to cut that off
full and reversing back into off-stump, Kamboj gets a thick inside edge to square leg
flicks this full ball to deep midwicket
the middle-stump has been knocked back and Sakib is pleased as punch! Dube backs away to drill this through the off side, but the late tail ensures he misses it altogether.
squeezes the yorker-length delivery to cover for a single
dug back to the bowler, who runs swiftly to his left to stop the ball
slips this full and too far wide outside off, left alone. CSK review the wide call and they lose it, because replays confirm this was well outside the imaginary line third umpires use as a reference
slower ball on a length outside leg stump, chipped down to midwicket for a single
gets the radar wrong again. The angle is invariably taking the ball down leg.
yorker on middle, dug out to long-on
reaches out to scythe this low full toss behind point, misses. Through to the keeper.
bunts this down to long-off for a single to get off the mark

that is a sensational catch from Aniket. Don't let the lack of celebration from fooling you into believing otherwise. This was full and angling into the pads, it was hit hard and flat to Aniket, the boundary rider at deep midwicket. He got to the ball, dived low to his right and plucked an absolute stunner!
gets this short ball high on the bat, rolls to deep square
pulled in front of square towards the man coming in from wide long-on, excellent running
tails this one away from the left-hander, but Dube ends up reaching out to drive and gets a thick edge past the keeper for four.
looks to biff this full toss over cover, but toe ends it straight to the fielder
slower length ball on leg stump, tucked wide of square leg
bunts one to long-off as they jog the single
pulled from outside off towards deep square for a single
full and angling into the pads, worked to deep square
floats one full but ends up slipping it down leg, through to the keeper. Wide signalled.
slower length ball on middle and leg, tucked to deep square leg
advances but also gets leg side of the ball and belts this juicy full toss into the gap between over and mid-off. Massive over that has brought CSK right back in it.
drilled down to long-on as he bowls full again from around the stumps
that's a monstrous hit from Dube! Right into his hitting arc and Dube hits this cleanly over long-on.
excellent bumper outside off, Dube looks to take on the short ball but bails out of the very last second
yorker-length outside off, squeezed back to the bowler who stops it on his followthrough
yorker-length on middle and leg, dug out to long-on
whips this low full toss down to deep midwicket. But because he has bowled from outside the wide line, it's been called a no-ball.
driven firmly to long-off as NKR bowls full again
bowls full outside off from around the stumps, drilled to long-off
slower and fuller on middle and leg, worked to long-on
excellent change of pace as he lands a leg-cutter on a length outside off, defended back
dug in short on middle, pulled to deep square leg
flat-bats this short of length delivery down to long-on
low full toss drifting across, smeared down to long-off
stabs this gently into the off side as they scamper a single

taken at long-off! This is top--class, nerveless bowling by the youngster. Not afraid to give it air, deceives Brewis in the air as he looks to go down the ground, but doesn't get to the pitch and ends up slicing it to Livingstone who didn't have to move an inch.
slaps this straight to point
flat-bats this short delivery down to wide long-on
tossed up and drifting across the right-hander, driven straight to cover
sways out of the way of this short ball outside off
zips one across outside off as he digs one in, Brewis lets this pass.
picks out deep square! Sarfaraz looks to flick this uppishly, the bottom hand comes off the bat handle. The helicopter loses steam, and it ends up being a simple catch to the boundary rider.
arches back to ramp it over short third, but gets beaten. Malinga rolled his fingers across the seam as he lands it on a length.
drills this full and straight delivery to mid-off
full and tailing into middle and leg, Short whips this full toss to deep midwicket
Right in the blockhole, and Short jumps on his feet post-facto. Lucky to not play this onto his feet. Down to long-on, he'll keep strike
Another clever flick, but only a single for his efforts. Ball almost died on him after landing on a length. He flicked his wrists with some tension... Ball winds down to mid-wicket
Sits up on a length. Boshes a drive while staying quite still. Gets it down to deep extra cover
On the stumps but down leg, on the pads. The flick flies off towards deep midwicket, fielder runs in from deep square to cut this off
Big heave but not much timing. On a length right outside off, swishes the ball towards deep midwicket
Full and on the stumps, flicked towards fine leg with ease
Pyrotechnics to get this racing towards deep fine leg! Was back of a length, rising right at his chest. He swiveled onto the back foot and opened up the leg side by maneuvering it down to deep fine
Rifled in quite full, in front of the stumos. Driven down to covers. Bowler absolutely misses his nonchalant collection at the non-striker's end. They collect an overthrow run
Spinning in, right on the stumps off a good length. Somehow cuts this towards point and dashes for the other end
Another wrong'un going across the right-handed batter. On a length, and he looks for a drive but gets an outside edge towards backward point
On a length, spinning away from outside off. Goes for a cut but hits it right down, smack dab middle of the pitch
Almost a catch at backward point! Was slinged around outside off. He went for an ungainly heave down the pitch. Almost carried to Hinge but not quite

Pristine timing on this one, but can't get it past backward point. The ball is back of a length, ambling towards him from outside off. Glided late but two fielders stationed there to cut off this exact shot
In the air for a moment. He goes on the backfoot to drive this well outside off

Confident strike down to deep extra cover! More worryingly, another sloppy effort from Livingstone down near the boundary. Was a confident drive off a good length, but should have been stopped once he got into the slide
On a length outside off and spinning back in. Short goes on the back foot and drives this down to the covers
Goes for an ungainly heave now... Sits up in front of the stumps once more, but he loses his shape as the ball dribbles past fine leg
And a slot ball's been punished first up! The ball was there to be hit, in the slot. He just swishes this through the line and gets it running down to a vacant mid-on
Misfield at covers allows a single for Sarfaraz. Was quite full on this occasion, but flew off the bat because it spun away. Collected closer to the ropes near deep covers
Outside off, minimal spin away, bunted towards point
Closer to the stumps, spins away from the right-hander. Another confident cut towards deep point
He's bowling this good length line outside off, angled outside off. He cuts this once more, towards deep backward point

Wide outside off once more, now he cuts this towards deep point. Runs in to save the boundary, the fielder there, but makes a mess of it by collecting the ball in-field with his foot touching the ropes
Angled wide outside off, spinning away even further. Batter reaches for it and cuts it late towards backward point
On a length outside off, glided late towards backward point
On a length, on the stumps, and flicked past mid-wicket
Back of a length, sits up from the pitch. Short sees this right in front of his eyes and smacks this across the line and towards deep midwicket
Full on the pads, Sarfaraz flicks this down towards mid-wicket and rushes down the pitch
Banged in short once more. But too high, and another wide is added to our tally
Dangled outside off on a length. Glides this late towards deep point and takes off for the other end

Malinga's struck first up! Bangs this in short and it is slanting down leg side. Gaikwad goes for a pull but one hand comes off the bat's handle. Ball bumps into his glove and rises in the air. Keeper there to collect this safely
On a great length, just outside off. Driven straight to mid-off
Full and on the stumps. On-drive towards mid-on, but no scope for a run here

And now to add to all that, Klaasen pulls out an absolute ripper of a catch at extra cover! Mhatre smashed this way away from his body, on a length outside off. No timing on this but it's still flying past Klaasen. He stretches in the air, absolutely taut in his posture, and plucks it out of thin air towards his left
Quite full, on the pads but towards leg side. Mhatre ambles to the other end... Almost hopping by the time he gets there. Surely he can't carry on here?

Full-ish and going down leg. A flick towards square leg and Gaikwad sets off for the other end. They even come back for the second by the time the ball comes back towards the pitch. But oh no, Mhatre's clutching his hamstring. He's thrown off his helmet. He might have done himself in there...
Now a French cut to add to the proceedings. He tries to run this down the pitch, to this back of a length ball outside off. But the slash takes the bottom edge, and runs down towards fine leg
Goes right for the blockhole, but slides down leg side and to the keeper. Arms splayed by the umpires. Reload...

Mhatre takes this on, and how! The ball sat up at him with innocuous pace, angling in from back of a length, outside off. He opened up his front foot and swung across the line to loft this towards cow corner
Anotherrr wide. Bangs this in on a short length and the batter jumps at it, still can't reach it...
Slow-ish outside off, on a length. Dabs this one towards covers and sets off once more. Smart strategy so far
Gentle drive towards extra cover. Sets off for the other end by the time the fielder runs in to throw this one towards the non-striker's end
Back of a length and angling into Gaikwad's hips, who pats this towards point late. Takes off for a quick single

Short ball, and it's rushed past Gaikwad. He thinks it might be a wide, so he ambles to the other end and talks to his partner about it. Reveiws it. So we're in with another long wait as the third umpire has a looksy. And the umpire stays with the on-ground call
On a length, he flicks this towards square leg but can't get it past the fielder. Asks Mhatre to abort the run at the other end
Night going from bad to worse for the pair of Hinge-Sakib. Pitched down leg side, and only slides further and further down leg and down to deep fine leg...
Now he boshes this one over mid-off. On a length and he just frees his hands at this one
Slashes this ball straight to deep covers! Was sitting up on a length, on a seventh stump line. Frees his arms and just boshes this through a tiny gap
Slapt over cover point, was sitting up to be hit...
Another bouncer. Ayush ducks out of the way, needn't have bothered. Too high, another wide and he's out of bouncers for the over too...
Bounces this one into the pitch, good pace as it rushes the batter. But it's banged in too short, umpire calls it a wide
Mhatre gets hold of it this time. Still dangled outside off, right in the arc for him to loft this over long-off
Full-ish length, kept well outside off. Deserved bosh with a drive from Mhatre, but finds the covers
Whaddashot! 133.1 clicks, rising at his chest from in front of the stumps. He jumped on one knee and just swivel-pulled this into the second tier beyond deep square leg. Gorgeous shot
Bowled too full once more, Gaikwad plays a beautiful on-drive with that high elbow. Ball runs down to the vacant long-on boundary
Now dangled on a length well outside off. In fact, it's too wide. Time to reload. Gaikwad let this one go quite early on

Klaasen's shelled this one! Was another full delivery, there to be hit. Mhatre goes downtown once more, but gets it off the bottom of his bat. Klaasen runs in from long-on and dives in the end, but cannot grab it even with his full dive
Full and close to the off stump. Solid drive played close to the body, but finds covers
A little shape as Ayush goes for another waft and misses... This time looking to go downtown. NKR bowled this in the slot, but rushed it through outside off to beat Mhatre
Goes for a drive away from his body and mistimes this, a bottom edge down into the pitch. Was kept outside off and he looked to hit this across the line

Samson's shovelled this right up in the air, and by the time it comes down, Klaasen collects it in his mits! He put out his hands and called for this quite early. The ball was back of a length, rushing Samson by rising right at him. Cramped on the pull and got the top-edge
Back of a length, but now it is angling into his pads. Gaikwad's happy to flick this towards deep fine leg
Too full outside off, and Gaikwad's got going! Was there in the slot and he just reaches out to thread this drive through the covers
Fuller and on the stumps on, Gaikwad pats this down the ground and back to the bowler
Another short ball, outside off and rising past Gaikwad's jump as he slashes at this
Late cut to this ball on a length outside off, backward point puts out a hand to slow it down

Samson's smashed him out of the park first up! Hinge goes back of a length, rising right at Samson, who swipes this towards deep square leg. For a moment, the fielder thought he stood a chance. He didn't
